auth_details: HTTP Basic Auth: username `api`, password = private API key (or domain sending key for /messages only). Keys from dashboard Account Settings → API Keys after self-serve signup.
free_tier_limits: No forever-free production plan. Free trial available on paid plans (Foundation/Scale include ~1-month trial); sandbox for testing. Paid plans start at Basic (~$15/mo for 10k emails/mo). Confirm current allotments on mailgun.com/pricing.
paid_plans: Basic from $15/mo (10k emails/mo); Foundation $35/mo (50k, 1-mo free trial); Scale $90/mo (100k, 1-mo free trial); Enterprise custom. Overages ~$1.10–$1.80 per 1k emails.
rate_limits: Varies by endpoint/account; response headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset; 429 on exceed. Metrics API: 500 req/10s. New accounts may face temporary hourly send caps until business verification.
example_request: curl --user 'api:YOUR_API_KEY' https://api.mailgun.net/v3/YOUR_DOMAIN_NAME/messages -F from='Mailgun Sandbox <postmaster@YOUR_DOMAIN_NAME>' -F to='recipient@example.com' -F subject='Hello' -F text='Testing Mailgun'
description: Mailgun (Sinch) is a developer-focused email delivery platform with a REST API for sending transactional and bulk email, inbound parsing/routing, templates, webhooks, suppressions, and analytics. US and EU regions are available; API access uses HTTP Basic Auth with private API keys. No forever-free production tier; paid plans start at Basic (~$15/mo for 10,000 emails/mo) with free trials on higher tiers.
